lines: Your account, your call: sign out of this device, or delete it for good.
Sign out ends this device's session on the backend at once, clears its cookie and opens sign-in. Your other devices stay signed in.
No connection? You stay signed in, and Settings says it couldn't sign you out.
Delete my account says what goes: your email, display name, progress and ride history. The button waits until you type delete.
Every session ends at once and the email is freed for a new, empty account. A daily job erases the rest, well inside thirty days.
Sign-in then says your account was deleted. If deleting fails, the dialog keeps your word and says so.
Phone to desktop, the same calm goodbye, and the dialog becomes a sheet.
What the tests prove: sign-out ends one session at once, deletion ends them all, and erasure follows within a day.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
